# MDSync core

Upstream: https://github.com/k1tbyte/mdsync
Commit: 6f0190efd517b709ff21c4d77bcc0b221bce52b6 (1.5.1, MIT).

Generated by tools/mdsync/build.mjs. The manifest publisher is modified to require atomic ETag writes; Obsidian host calls use tools/mdsync/host.ts. Other algorithms are bundled from the pinned source.

Bundled third-party dependencies retain their legal comments in core.js. Input files are recorded in inputs.json.
